answer.reason: HealthEquity administers HSAs, FSAs, HRAs, COBRA and commuter accounts for employers and account holders. eHealth is a commission-based insurance broker and marketplace that enrolls consumers, mostly Medicare-eligible, in carrier plans. The two share the broad healthcare-benefits space and the US market. The products differ (account custody and administration versus insurance brokerage), as do the main buyers and the way each earns money.
